definitions.explanation: A mathematical expression or formula — a written combination of numbers, variables, and operators. Used in mathematics, physics, chemistry, and other technical fields.
A formal ceremony or ritual occasion. Often appears as a suffix on the names of specific ceremonies (e.g. {結婚式|けっこんしき} wedding ceremony, {卒業式|そつぎょうしき} graduation ceremony).

notes:
Two main uses share the same kanji: a math/science formula, and a formal ceremony.

SENSE 1 — FORMULA:
- ⟦{方程式|ほうていしき}→方程式：04795_houteishiki⟧: equation
- ⟦{計算式|けいさんしき}→計算式：27948_keisanshiki⟧: calculation formula
- ⟦{化学式|かがくしき}→化学式：24804_kagakushiki⟧: chemical formula
- ⟦{式|しき}→〜式：02000_shiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to set up a formula
- ⟦{式|しき}→〜式：02000_shiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧: to solve an equation

SENSE 2 — CEREMONY:
Very often used as a suffix attached to the type of event:
- ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧: wedding ceremony
- ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧: graduation ceremony
- ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧: school entrance ceremony
- ⟦{葬式|そうしき}→葬式：04389_soushiki⟧: funeral

The standalone noun ⟦{式|しき}→〜式：02000_shiki⟧ usually refers to whichever ceremony is salient in context.
